labelAssociation.evidence: addons/web/static/src/views/form/ — a form field renders <label class="o_form_label"> beside a widget carrying name="<field>"
labelAssociation.note: The name attribute is the model's field name and is the strongest handle in the app: it is not translated, unlike every visible label. Prefer it.

naming.pattern: snake_case .js beside a .xml template of the same name, under each addon's static/src

hazards.impact: page objects cannot be generated from routes. Every screen must come from a crawl, and navigation between them is by menu click, not by goto().
locators rest on the name attribute, roles and Bootstrap/Owl class names.
a list row becomes an editable form in place; the same cell is a value and an input depending on state.
what exists depends on which addons are installed, so an analysis of the clone over-reports what any instance serves.
